title: Three pointers keep four regions: small | equal | unexplored | large
caption: Here the array is partitioned around the pivot 5. The window is the unexplored region nums[mid .. high]. Everything left of low is < 5, low .. mid−1 is == 5, and everything right of high is > 5.

frames.text: Start: nothing is classified yet. low = mid = 0 and high = n − 1, so the whole array is the unexplored window and the other three regions are empty.

Part-way through, all four regions are visible: [3, 2] small (before low), [5, 5] equal (low .. mid−1), [5, 1] unexplored (mid .. high) and [9, 8] large (after high). Each step classifies nums[mid] and shrinks the window by one.
mid has passed high, so the unexplored region is empty and the array is partitioned. That's one pass with O(1) extra space.
